title: Edge tab opens into a scrolling icon rail
summary: A small labelled tab grows out of a panel seam, morphs into a three-icon rail, and a hover dot drives it to scroll one item at a time up and back before it folds away. A loopable nav pattern demo.
use_when: Showing a compact side navigation or quick-switch rail in a web or desktop app
A loopable UI micro-demo for a landing page, docs or a social post
Explaining that a rail holds more items than it shows (scroll on hover)
A silent clip where one interaction pattern is the whole message

look.type_style: small geometric sans, sentence case, one word set vertically (rotated 90 deg) inside the tab, ~4 % H; outline icons ~4.5 % H, one hue each

sfx.event: tab grows out of the seam

structure.shot: split frame: flat light panel left, warm abstract wallpaper right; a dark tab with a vertical one-word label and grid glyph grows from the seam
structure.motion: tab scales out from the seam (origin left-centre) f2 to f6, springs.layout 4 fr (overshoot not measurable); label and glyph ride inside it; hold to f28

structure.shot: the tab becomes a rail of three outline icons in three hues; a small dark hover dot rests next to the middle icon
structure.motion: label crossfades out while icons fade in f28 to f32, tab height grows ~20 % on springs.layout 4 fr; hover dot appears f29; hold 43 fr

structure.shot: rail scrolls by one: a new icon enters at the top, the bottom icon leaves; the dot follows the item it hovers
structure.motion: column shifts one slot down f76 to f81, springs.ui 5 fr; entering icon fades in at the top, leaving icon fades out at the bottom over 3 fr; dot glides with the column

structure.shot: the dot climbs to the top icon and the rail scrolls one more item in
structure.motion: dot moves up first f95 to f100 easings.outQuint 5 fr, then column shifts one slot f100 to f103 springs.ui 3 fr with the same fade in/out; hold f103 to f133

structure.shot: the dot drops down twice and the rail scrolls back two items, returning to the first icon set
structure.motion: step 1: dot down f133 to f135, column shifts up f136 to f138; step 2: dot down f145 to f147, column shifts up f148 to f149; each shift springs.ui 3 fr, dot easings.outQuint 2 to 3 fr

structure.shot: the dot fades, the rail folds back into the seam, empty split frame holds and matches frame 0 for the loop
structure.motion: dot fades f156 to f157; icons shrink and fade f164 to f165, rail collapses into the seam f164 to f168, easings.inExpo 4 fr; empty hold 27 fr

params.brand: any brand.json: bg for the light panel, surface/fg for the rail, accent for one icon
params.content.label: one word shown vertically in the closed tab (menu name)
params.content.items: 5 icons (LineIcon names + hue), 3 visible at once
params.timing.steps: scroll script, e.g. [+1, +1, -1, -1]; each step: dot moves 3 to 5 fr, column shifts 3 to 5 fr
params.panelSplit: x of the seam as a share of width (reference 0.49)
params.wallpaper: right-side backdrop: gradient colours or an image
params.fps: composition fps (default 30); timing scales with it

notes: Single shot, no cuts; rows split at state changes measured from 30 fps strips (1 fr). Every motion is short: tab open 4 fr, morph 4 fr, each scroll 3 to 5 fr, collapse 4 fr; long holds between keep it readable. The dot leads the scroll in steps 2 to 4 (moves to the edge item, then the column shifts). Loopable: last frames equal frame 0. No camera move (motion.json zoom under 0.3 %/s, noise). Theme mixed: the frame is half light panel, half warm mid-tone wallpaper for the whole runtime. Palette from palettegen misses the small dark rail colour (~#14063A by eye). sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference is silent). Proposed terms (not in vocabulary): edge-tab-reveal, rail-scroll, fold-away.
